# Wayfinder ESLint Fixture Specification

<!-- Last audited at: 2026-07-10 -->

## EARS Requirements

**WF-ESLINT-FIXTURE-01** When lint-context tests load the flat ESLint fixture, the system shall expose deterministic JavaScript configuration inputs.

**WF-ESLINT-FIXTURE-02** If fixture configuration is intentionally invalid, the system shall preserve the expected lint-context failure signal.

## BDD Traceability

- Feature: `agm/test/bdd/features/cross_language_implementation_guardrails.feature`
